title: Enablement Kit Links + Version Tracker (Enterprise Security Enablement Kit)
body:
Owner note (Talia): This sheet is the single source of truth for (a) canonical links Sales/SE should send to customers, (b) current approved version/date, and (c) which HubSpot snippets/templates reference each artifact. When updating any artifact, you must also update the referencing snippets (or at minimum validate the links still resolve) and note changes in the last column.

Conventions:
- Source of truth: Confluence = published; Drive = draft/in-progress; Docs site = public-friendly. Avoid sending Drive drafts to customers unless explicitly approved.
- Access: Public = docs site; Customer shareable = OK to send without NDA; NDA required = request via evidence process; Internal only = do not share.
- Version format: YYYY.MM (minor updates) or YYYY.MM.DD (hotfixes).
- Last reviewed = date of latest cross-functional review (Security/GRC + Product Sec PM at minimum).
